addr: BACK SIDE, BANNERGHATTA ROAD, near SHOPPERS STOP, NS PALYA, BTM 2ND STAGE, BTM Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076, India

rev.t: PM Kalyana Mantapa is a stunning wedding venue! The grand architecture, beautiful golden décor, elegant interiors, and colourful lighting create a luxurious and festive atmosphere. The entrance itself looks magnificent and welcoming. …

Nice and newly renovated wedding hall. It was spacious for wedding with guests of 500 to 600. Nice parking in front of the hall and in the basement. Small playground for the kids. Only thing I didn't like was that no handwash after going to toilets at the dinning hall.

The Kalyana Mantapa is very good and gives a great first impression. The aesthetic look while entering the hall is beautiful—it really feels divine and welcoming. The ambience is pleasant and well-designed overall. …
